notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/4bd49905692eba2dfc500232276219fab503294f.png[/img]

Hey guys! From now on we will update the patch notes here as well so that everyone can keep up on what's happening in the game!

- the Sunblaze team

[h2]--- PATCH NOTES ---[/h2]

- fixed a bug where the chapter stats in the chapter select screen aren't always centered
- fixed a bug where spikes could kill you if they're on a jump-through platform and covered by a falling block
- fixed a bug where sometimes the falling block sounds kept looping
- fixed a bug where Josie's hair color was sometimes black
- fixed a bug where you would sometimes die after leaving the fireball mode
- fixed some decorative inconsistencies
- made the last level of chapter 4 hard mode harder to skip
- reworked the saving so a computer crash is less likely to cause a corrupted save file
- the game now keeps more backups of save files
- made improvements for easier livesplit integration
- fixed a typo in the dialogue

notes.title: 10 days after release!
notes.notes:
10 days after release and we're still going strong? [h3]Oh yeah.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/109017e3494d7707b2d79a74a54f20e8d4838e67.png[/img]

The wait, the release, the hype, the aftermath. It's all been crazy and chaotic (for the team at least, hopefully it seems like we know what we're doing!) but now that the game is out there, it's time to build on the foundation that we have made.

We've had streamers of various sizes, journalists from numerous publications and players from different backgrounds all show love and interest towards Sunblaze. It's been 10 days since the initial release now and we still keep rallying up interest from lots of people who learn about the games existence! And since it's been such a warm welcome for the game, we want to keep bringing people to it.

Have you been enjoying Sunblaze? 

[h3]Leave a Steam review![/h3] 

It's quick and easy and really helps us a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/338330d5a67643e2661e2ef1a805f18184ce1966.png[/img]

Sunblaze has been bringing all kinds of gamers - platformers, speedrunners, adventurers and everyone else as well - together. And since we want to build up on the game, we might be planning something special small little something! No spoilers yet though. 

[h3]Keep your eyes and ears open![/h3]

- the Sunblaze team

notes.title: It's time to heal your thumbs before the release
notes.notes:
It's been a long way to get here, and now is the time for rest. Our fingers need healing and yours should take a break too - for the full release is just around the corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/f11e2425ccadf29bb314b8969ef77716030d2d78.png[/img]

It's a sad thing to take away the demo, I know. But we really want to focus on the release of the full version and taking away some extra variables will make it just a little bit easier for us to get everything just right!

We've seen how much some of you have played the demo. [i]Amazing.[/i] We are extremely thankful to everyone who has been with us during this time, and that's all the more reason why we want to focus on making the full version as great as we can for you. A small break before you get to hop on the full experience will only make it all better, I promise!

[h3]To keep it short, here's what's up:[/h3]

- Sunblaze demo will be deactivated some time during [b]May 13th[/b] (so only a few days left!)
- Rest your fingers and lower your stress levels for a couple of weeks
- The full release of Sunblaze will come out [b]June 3rd 6 AM PDT[/b]
- Thank you.

Oh and in case you already haven't, you should join us waiting for the release at Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/jucwgwjGTz]https://discord.gg/jucwgwjGTz[/url]

[i]See you soon![/i]
- the Sunblaze team

notes.title: Sunblaze release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Save the date! Sunblaze release will happen on [b]June 3rd 2021[/b], 6 AM PDT![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/194d65d9e1cc0c3955cf549ba8e215ccf6b38587.png[/img]

[h3][b]Are you ready?[/b][/h3]

We know many of you feel like you can't wait any longer and getting Sunblaze ready for release has been no easy task. But even though we still have a ton of work to get done, we have now chosen the day for Sunblaze to finally come out! And it's right around the corner!

As Josie and everyone else too are about to be ready for the release you better get ready as well, because it's going to be a wild ride in the simulator. We already have well over 500 puzzling levels waiting, and might throw in a couple extra hard ones as well, just for you. 

[b]Sunblazes journey through the simulator will be nothing short of challenging![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932393/489fba7714d4cae2ba68651e50ce04aaa44a853c.gif[/img]

We are all super exited and can hardly wait -
[h2]this is going to be [b]LIT[/b]![/h2]


Sunblaze release date: [b]June 3rd 2021[/b], 6 AM PDT.

- the Sunblaze team
